title: Asha approves
story: The INR 6,000 party order steps up. Asha gets a link, sees the amount, the shop and the reasons, and taps Approve. The approval is recorded, and ShopBot may now pay, within 15 minutes.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order the party food from FreshMart for Saturday.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The party order at FreshMart comes to INR 6,000. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This one needs your approval, Asha. I've sent it to your phone.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Asha approved. Checking the approval before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The bank takes a couple of minutes to confirm a card payment.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

what_to_notice: Approve on Asha's phone is the real consent screen, opened on a real Consent link. ShopBot can't approve anything: it only waits, checks the Consent request, and pays once Asha has said yes.
